title: Per second per second.
html_source: Bloom’s mind returns to physics of gravity on falling objects when he thinks “drop in”.

anchor.prefix: e folded Freeman from his sidepocket, unfolded it, rolled it lengthwise in a baton and tapped it at each sauntering step against his trouserleg. Careless air: just drop in to see.
